contea di ritrovamento: Worcestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman coin: a silver denarius of Carausius dating to AD 286 to 293 (Reece Period 14). RENOVA ROMAN reverse type depicting wolf and twins. RSR issue of London. RIC V, pt 2, p. 512, no. 571. The Wolf and Twins reverse is one of the more common reverse types for silver denarii of Carausius, but this is only the second example with the legend RENOVA ROMAN that Sam Moorhead has seen; the obverse…
